_meta.description: GUI Agent Causal Failure Attribution v1.0 — Step × Module × Function × Mechanism × Object × Explanation × Evidence 平级维度归因

planner.label: Planner（规划器，含回顾）
planner.description: 接收截图+任务+历史，输出 thought/review/plan_action/memory；回顾（review）由 planner 自身产出，非独立模块

grounder.label: Grounder（坐标定位）
grounder.description: 将语义动作描述映射为屏幕坐标

memory.label: Memory（跨步记忆）
memory.description: 跨步维持 kv 记忆存储，由 planner 决定读写

environment_app.label: Environment / App（环境／应用）
environment_app.description: 外部环境或App自身异常。用于Initial Function E1；不是模型内部模块。

F1.label: F1: Perception / Observation
F1.description: 对当前可观测 GUI 信息的获取、识别或语义感知发生错误
F1.include: 漏掉弹窗；OCR 错；关键控件漏识别；图标/文本/页面语义识别错误
F1.exclude: UI 信息已经被正确感知，但对当前状态推断错误 → State Estimation

F2.label: F2: State Estimation
F2.description: 已有 observation 基本正确，但对当前环境状态、任务进度或 latent state 的推断错误
F2.include: 误以为已经滑到底；误以为已登录；误以为筛选生效；错误判断当前任务阶段
F2.exclude: 专门判断'刚才那一步是否成功'出错 → Verification；状态已判断正确但下一步策略错 → Planning

F3.label: F3: Goal / Constraint Understanding
F3.description: 对用户目标、约束、成功条件或任务语义理解错误
F3.include: 把'最晚航班'理解成'当前可见最晚航班'；遗漏价格/距离等约束；误解完成条件
F3.exclude: 目标理解正确但下一步选择错误 → Planning

F4.label: F4: Planning / Decision Making
F4.description: Goal 与当前 state 基本正确，但选择了错误的子目标、策略、步骤顺序或下一步操作
F4.include: 应继续搜索却决定提交；走错功能路径；错误 task decomposition；premature termination
F4.exclude: 语义动作已确定，但映射到错误 UI 对象 → Target Grounding；上游 state 已错误且计划只是合理跟随 → Propagation

F5.label: F5: Target Grounding
F5.description: 已确定正确语义动作，但将语义目标映射到错误 GUI 元素
F5.include: 想点'收藏'却定位到'点赞'；多个相似按钮选错；正确 target 语义映射到错误 widget
F5.exclude: 目标元素正确但动作类型/参数错误 → Action Formulation

F6.label: F6: Action Formulation
F6.description: 目标对象基本正确，但构造出的具体 action、参数、文本、方向或时机错误
F6.include: 应长按却点击；滑动方向错误；输入文本错误；action parameter 生成错误
F6.exclude: action 命令正确但设备未忠实执行 → Device Execution

F7.label: F7: Verification / Outcome Assessment
F7.description: 对某次操作是否成功、expected transition 是否发生、任务是否完成的判断错误
F7.include: 点击未生效却认为成功；页面未跳转却判定成功；false positive/false negative；任务未完成却 terminate
F7.exclude: 更长期/整体的当前状态判断错误 → State Estimation

F8.label: F8: Memory / State Tracking
F8.description: 历史状态、用户约束、任务进度或关键事实的记录、更新、保留或读取发生错误
F8.include: 忘记已完成步骤；保留 stale state；错误记录用户约束；hallucinated memory
F8.exclude: 当前即时页面信息解读错误 → Perception / State Estimation

F9.label: F9: Device Execution
F9.description: 上层 action 已正确形成，但 controller/device 层未忠实执行
F9.include: coordinate mismatch；action transmission failure；text encoding failure；screenshot/device interaction failure
F9.exclude: Executor 自己生成了错误坐标/参数 → Target Grounding / Action Formulation

E1.label: E1: Environment / App Behavior
E1.description: Agent 的 observation、decision 与 execution 基本正确，但环境/App 对正确操作异常响应
E1.include: app no response；unexpected popup；incorrect navigation；page timeout；app crash；state reversal
E1.exclude: Agent 自身已经产生错误判断/操作 → 归对应 agent function

E2.label: E2: Task Precondition（预置问题）
E2.include: 账号／权限限制；目标内容不足；指定功能／选项不可用；无符合条件的结果；容量／业务规则限制
E2.exclude: App真正异常仍用E1；模型独立错误按对应F类；通信门控未放行及需人工准备的登录等仍按已确认重跑口径处置

R1.label: R1: Detection Failure
R1.description: 存在可观察异常和恢复机会，但系统没有意识到已经发生错误
R1.include: action 无效却完全认为正常；页面状态与预期明显不一致但未触发 recovery
R1.exclude: 已经知道'有异常'，但不知道异常为什么发生 → Diagnosis

R2.label: R2: Diagnosis Failure
R2.description: 已检测到异常，但错误理解异常来源、当前真实状态或失败原因
R2.include: 知道点击没成功，却误判为网络问题；实际 target 点错却认为页面加载慢
R2.exclude: 原因已经判断正确，但恢复策略错误 → Recovery Planning

R3.label: R3: Recovery Planning Failure
R3.description: 错误已经被正确识别/诊断，但生成的恢复策略不正确或不足以消除错误
R3.include: 应重新滑动却返回首页；应撤销却继续原错误路径；反复执行无效 recovery
R3.exclude: 恢复策略本身正确，但后续模块未采用正确信号 → Feedback Integration；策略正确但动作执行失败 → Recovery Execution

R4.label: R4: Feedback Integration / Adoption Failure
R4.description: 正确的异常、verification 或 recovery 信息已经由某模块产生，但后续负责决策的模块没有正确采用
R4.include: Reflector 明确报告 action failed，Planner 仍按 success state 推进；memory 已更新但 Planner 继续使用 stale belief
R4.exclude: Reflector 本身没有检测到错误 → Detection；已经采用正确 feedback 但 recovery action 执行失败 → Recovery Execution

R5.label: R5: Recovery Execution Failure
R5.description: 恢复方案与目标基本正确，但具体恢复操作没有被正确实现
R5.include: 正确 recovery target 选定后坐标执行错误；controller repair action 未生效；正确修复动作传输失败
R5.exclude: recovery strategy 本身错误 → Recovery Planning

missing_verification.label: Missing Verification
missing_verification.description: 系统未对操作结果进行验证

insufficient_verification.label: Insufficient Verification
insufficient_verification.description: 验证存在但不充分，遗漏关键信号

incorrect_inference.label: Incorrect Inference
incorrect_inference.description: 基于正确信息推导出错误结论

incorrect_assumption.label: Incorrect Assumption
incorrect_assumption.description: 在没有充分证据的情况下做出错误假设

incomplete_information_use.label: Incomplete Information Use
incomplete_information_use.description: 未使用所有可用信息进行决策

stale_information.label: Stale Information
stale_information.description: 使用过时信息导致决策错误

information_inconsistency.label: Information Inconsistency
information_inconsistency.description: 不同来源信息之间存在矛盾未解决

premature_commitment.label: Premature Commitment
premature_commitment.description: 在信息不足时过早做出确定性判断

corrective_feedback_ignored.label: Corrective Feedback Ignored
corrective_feedback_ignored.description: 正确的纠正反馈被忽略

feedback_misinterpreted.label: Feedback Misinterpreted
feedback_misinterpreted.description: 环境或模块反馈被错误解读

missing_update.label: Missing Update
missing_update.description: 状态变化后内存未更新

missing_cross_module_communication.label: Missing Cross-Module Communication
missing_cross_module_communication.description: 模块间缺少必要的信息传递

execution_mismatch.label: Execution Mismatch
execution_mismatch.description: 动作指令与执行结果不匹配

novel_mechanism.label: Novel Mechanism（新机制）
novel_mechanism.description: 现有 canonical mechanism 无法表达其核心 causal mechanism。需在 explanation 中描述。

account_permission.label: 账号／权限限制
account_permission.description: 仅与Initial Function E2搭配，描述可证实的预置限制，不表示模型模块犯错

insufficient_content.label: 目标内容不足
insufficient_content.description: 仅与Initial Function E2搭配，描述可证实的预置限制，不表示模型模块犯错

unavailable_option.label: 指定功能／选项不可用
unavailable_option.description: 仅与Initial Function E2搭配，描述可证实的预置限制，不表示模型模块犯错

no_matching_result.label: 无符合条件的结果
no_matching_result.description: 仅与Initial Function E2搭配，描述可证实的预置限制，不表示模型模块犯错

capacity_business_limit.label: 容量／业务规则限制
capacity_business_limit.description: 仅与Initial Function E2搭配，描述可证实的预置限制，不表示模型模块犯错

invalid_action_format.label: 动作格式错误 / Invalid Action Format
invalid_action_format.description: 动作生成模块输出不合法JSON、命令语法或缺少必需结构，导致解析失败；Initial使用F6，Module按真实输出来源选Planner或Grounder。合法动作的参数值错仍用原参数机制；合法输出被适配器错误拒绝不属本项

task_completion_state.label: Task Completion State（任务完成状态）

planner.label: Planner (includes review)
planner.description: Receives screenshot+task+history, outputs thought/review/plan_action/memory; review is produced by planner itself

grounder.label: Grounder
grounder.description: Maps semantic action description to screen coordinates

memory.label: Memory
memory.description: Cross-step kv memory storage, read/write controlled by planner

environment_app.label: Environment / App
environment_app.description: External environment or App behavior. Used with Initial Function E1; not an internal model module.

F1.label: F1: Perception / Observation
F1.description: Error in acquiring or recognizing observable GUI information

F2.label: F2: State Estimation
F2.description: Correct observation but wrong inference about environment state

F3.label: F3: Goal / Constraint Understanding
F3.description: Misunderstanding of user goals, constraints, or success conditions

F4.label: F4: Planning / Decision Making
F4.description: Wrong subgoal, strategy, or operation selected despite correct state/goal

F5.label: F5: Target Grounding
F5.description: Correct semantic action mapped to wrong GUI element

F6.label: F6: Action Formulation
F6.description: Correct target but wrong action type, parameter, or timing

F7.label: F7: Verification / Outcome Assessment
F7.description: Incorrect judgment of action success or expected transition

F8.label: F8: Memory / State Tracking
F8.description: Errors in recording, updating, or reading historical state

F9.label: F9: Device Execution
F9.description: Correct action command but controller/device fails to execute

E1.label: E1: Environment / App Behavior
E1.description: Correct agent but abnormal environment/app response

E2.label: E2: Task Precondition
E2.include: Account or permission restrictions; insufficient content; unavailable features or options; no matching results; capacity or business-rule restrictions.
E2.exclude: Actual App malfunction remains E1; independent model errors use the relevant F function. Preserve the agreed rerun disposition for missing communication authorization or manual login preparation.

R1.label: R1: Detection Failure
R1.description: Observable anomaly exists but system is unaware of error

R2.label: R2: Diagnosis Failure
R2.description: Anomaly detected but source or cause misdiagnosed

R3.label: R3: Recovery Planning Failure
R3.description: Error correctly identified but recovery strategy is wrong

R4.label: R4: Feedback Integration / Adoption Failure
R4.description: Correct information generated but not adopted by decision module

R5.label: R5: Recovery Execution Failure
R5.description: Correct recovery action not correctly implemented

novel_mechanism.label: Novel Mechanism
novel_mechanism.description: For mechanisms not covered by canonical set

account_permission.label: Account / Permission Restriction
account_permission.description: Used with Initial Function E2 only; describes an evidenced prerequisite restriction, not a model-module failure.

insufficient_content.label: Insufficient Target Content
insufficient_content.description: Used with Initial Function E2 only; describes an evidenced prerequisite restriction, not a model-module failure.

unavailable_option.label: Required Feature / Option Unavailable
unavailable_option.description: Used with Initial Function E2 only; describes an evidenced prerequisite restriction, not a model-module failure.

no_matching_result.label: No Matching Result
no_matching_result.description: Used with Initial Function E2 only; describes an evidenced prerequisite restriction, not a model-module failure.

capacity_business_limit.label: Capacity / Business Rule Restriction
capacity_business_limit.description: Used with Initial Function E2 only; describes an evidenced prerequisite restriction, not a model-module failure.

invalid_action_format.label: Invalid Action Format
invalid_action_format.description: The action-generating module emits invalid JSON, command syntax, or mandatory structure, preventing parsing. Use F6 for Initial and identify the actual generating Planner or Grounder. Incorrect values in parseable actions retain existing parameter mechanisms; adapter rejection of valid output is excluded.
